question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are friends and avid readers who occasionally trade books. At the start of the semester, they each buy one new book: Alice gets Candide, Bob gets Beloved, Claire gets Siddhartha, Dave gets Dracula, Eve gets Hamlet, Fred gets Dune, and Gertrude gets Jane Eyre.
As the semester proceeds, they start trading around the new books. First, Fred and Eve swap books. Then, Claire and Eve swap books. Then, Eve and Dave swap books. Then, Alice and Claire swap books. Then, Alice and Claire swap books. Then, Alice and Eve swap books. Finally, Fred and Bob swap books. At the end of the semester, Claire has
Options:
(A) Candide
(B) Beloved
(C) Siddhartha
(D) Dracula
(E) Hamlet
(F) Dune
(G) Jane Eyre
solution:
Reader order in every row: Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude.
Initial books: Candide, Beloved, Siddhartha, Dracula, Hamlet, Dune, Jane Eyre
1. Fred ↔ Eve: Candide, Beloved, Siddhartha, Dracula, Dune, Hamlet, Jane Eyre
2. Claire ↔ Eve: Candide, Beloved, Dune, Dracula, Siddhartha, Hamlet, Jane Eyre
3. Eve ↔ Dave: Candide, Beloved, Dune, Siddhartha, Dracula, Hamlet, Jane Eyre
4. Alice ↔ Claire: Dune, Beloved, Candide, Siddhartha, Dracula, Hamlet, Jane Eyre
5. Alice ↔ Claire: Candide, Beloved, Dune, Siddhartha, Dracula, Hamlet, Jane Eyre
6. Alice ↔ Eve: Dracula, Beloved, Dune, Siddhartha, Candide, Hamlet, Jane Eyre
7. Fred ↔ Bob: Dracula, Hamlet, Dune, Siddhartha, Candide, Beloved, Jane Eyre
Claire has Dune, option (F).
Final answer: (F)
